title: Stepper Journey Map
description: Horizontal service blueprint journey map aligning user persona stages with system reactions.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Journey Blueprint Inspection: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
